description: Create a new work item in the backlog (status BACKLOG). Requires `write` scope.

allowedWritePaths.description: File write scope: a hard boundary on the repository files the crew may change, as relative patterns (literal, * or **; [ and ] are literal characters, so src/pages/[slug].astro is a valid entry). null/omitted is unrestricted; [] is read-only. Any write scope also withholds connected (MCP) tools that can write; tools their server marks readOnlyHint stay. Set before dispatch; locked once crewId exists. To point the crew at a monorepo folder without restricting it, use folderScope.

assigneeUid.description: Human executor — an approved editor+ member, by uid or email (anyforge_list_members lists both). Files the item for a person; it still lands in BACKLOG until `begin`.

attachments.description: Evidence references such as URLs or storage references. Do not send raw file bytes.

branchName.description: Branch this item's crew works on, instead of the name derived from the workspace's branch naming (for example feature/csv-export). Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '/'; not main, master or another integration branch. An expedited item still uses the hotfix prefix unless this name starts with it.

classOfService.description: File this as an interrupt in the expedite lane.

continuesPullRequest.description: When this work continues an open pull request, its link (https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{number}) in the item's repository. AnyForge reads the pull request and sets the item's branch to its head and its base branch to its base, so the crew commits to that pull request instead of opening a new one. Use this instead of naming the branch or pull request in the description: a crew only works on the branch the item names. Refused when the pull request is merged, closed, from a fork or in another repository.

dedupeByExternalId.description: Legacy: use externalRef.dedupe. With externalId, return the item that already carries it instead of filing a second one.

dependsOn.description: Work-item ids that must finish first.

estimate.description: Effort estimate as a person says it — "2h", "1.5d", "1w", or a number of days. Stored as operator-days.

estimatePoints.description: Point estimate on the point scale this workspace uses (Fibonacci, linear, exponential, or a T-shirt size such as "M"). Refused while the workspace estimates in time. Points never feed capacity plans.

externalId.description: Legacy: use externalRef.key. The id this work has in another system, shown in the title as [ID].

externalRef.description: Where this work lives in another system, the same shape the item's externalRef reads back. Do not send it with externalId or dedupeByExternalId.

dedupe.description: When an item in the workspace already carries this key, return it (existing: true) instead of filing a second one. Nothing is written. Use it when the same request may be sent again. Default false.

inTitle.description: false files the title as written; true or absent shows the key in the title as [KEY] - title. Use false for an opaque record id.

key.description: The id in the other system: a tracker key such as PROJ-42, or a CRM record id.

url.description: Optional http(s) link to the record in the other system.

folderScope.description: Repository folder this item's work is in, for a monorepo (for example apps/web). The crew installs that folder's Node project, is told to work there, runs tests from it by default, and gets that folder's repository skills first. It restricts nothing and withholds no tools: to limit which files the crew may change, use allowedWritePaths. Not targetPath, which is migration only.

incident.description: Incident severity and impact metadata when the item is an incident.

migrationStrategy.description: Migration only: copy, history-preserving, or subtree.

priority.description: P0 is highest priority; `none` files the item with no priority.

reportedMilestoneId.description: Program milestone (wave) this was REPORTED against — provenance only, never scheduling. Requires an initiative that belongs to a program, and must be one of that program's milestone ids.

sourceGithubBranch.description: Migration only: source branch to copy from.

sourceGithubRepo.description: Migration only: read-only source repository to copy from. The fields below need it.

sourceGithubSha.description: Migration only: source commit to copy from.

sourcePath.description: Migration only: path in the source repository to copy.

tags.description: Labels for the new item (the Console's Labels field). Labels are trimmed, lower-cased and deduplicated; at most 20 per item, 40 characters each. A label in one of the workspace's label groups replaces the item's other label from that group.

targetGithubBranch.description: Base branch this item's crew branches from and opens its pull request against (for example feature/x), instead of the initiative's source branch. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '/'; an integration branch such as develop is allowed here. It must exist on the remote: dispatch fails with base_branch_missing, naming it, rather than falling back to the initiative's branch. Not the head branch: use branchName for that. When continuesPullRequest is also set, the pull request's base wins and a different value is refused.

targetGithubRepo.description: Repository this item will modify; must be one of the initiative's repositories. To scope the work to a folder, use folderScope, not targetPath.

targetPath.description: Migration only: where the copied source lands in the target repository. Not a working folder for ordinary work; use folderScope for that.

name: anyforge_create_work_item
title: Create work item
